bookInfo.name: Old History of the Five Dynasties

title.zh: 卷四十 唐書16: 明宗本紀六
title.en: Volume 40 Book of Later Tang 16: Mingzong Annals 6
title.raw: 卷四十 唐書16: 明宗本紀六 Volume 40 Book of Later Tang 16: Mingzong Annals 6

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，王晏球奏，此月三日收復定州，獲王都首級，生擒契丹托諾等二千餘人。

translations.literal: Second month, yisi: Wang Yanqiu memorialized that on the third of this month Ding prefecture had been recovered, Wang Du's head was taken, and more than two thousand Khitan including Tuonuo were captured alive.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the second month Wang Yanqiu reported recovering Ding on the third, taking Wang Du's head and capturing over two thousand Khitan including Tuonuo alive.

sentences.zh: 百僚稱賀已畢，乃詔取今月二十四日車駕還東京。

translations.literal: When the hundred officials' congratulations were finished, an edict then set the twenty-fourth of this month for the imperial carriage to return to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: After congratulations Mingzong ordered the court to return to the Eastern Capital on the twenty-fourth.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以北面行營招討使、宋州節度使王晏球為鄆州節度使，加兼侍中；

translations.literal: On xinhai, northern campaign headquarters commissioner and Song prefecture military commissioner Wang Yanqiu was made Yan prefecture military commissioner with added concurrent Attendant-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wang Yanqiu of Song became Yan commissioner with attendant-in-chief rank;

sentences.zh: 以北面行營副招討使、滄州節度使李從敏為定州節度使；

translations.literal: northern campaign deputy commissioner and Cang prefecture military commissioner Li Congmin was made Ding prefecture military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Congmin of Cang became Ding commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以北面行營兵馬都監、鄭州防禦使張虔釗為滄州節度使；

translations.literal: northern campaign horse-army commander-in-chief and Zhengzhou defense commissioner Zhang Qianzhao was made Cang prefecture military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: and Zhang Qianzhao of Zheng became Cang commissioner;

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使趙德鈞加兼侍中。

translations.literal: Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun was given added concurrent Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou received attendant-in-chief rank.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以樞密使趙敬怡權知汴州軍州事。

translations.literal: On yimao, Privy Commissioner Zhao Jingyi was ordered to act as regent of Bian prefecture military headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhao Jingyi acted as regent at Bian.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，邢州奏，定州送到偽太子李繼陶，已處置訖。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Xing prefecture memorialized that the false heir Li Jitao sent from Ding had been disposed of.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Xing reported the false heir Li Jitao from Ding had been executed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，帝御咸安樓受定州俘馘，百官就列，宣露布於樓前，禮畢，以王都首級獻於太社。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Emperor took the Xian'an Tower to receive Ding captives and heads; the hundred officials took their places; the victory bulletin was proclaimed before the tower; when the rite was finished, Wang Du's head was offered at the Grand Shrine of State.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Mingzong at the Xian'an Tower received Ding captives, proclaimed the victory bulletin, and offered Wang Du's head at the Grand Shrine.

sentences.zh: 王都男四人、弟一人，禿餒父子二人，並磔於市。

translations.literal: Wang Du's four sons, one younger brother, and the father-and-son pair Tu Nei were all dismembered in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Du's four sons and brother and the Tu Nei father and son were dismembered in the market.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：尚書兵部宣露布於樓前，宣訖，尚書刑部侍郎張文寶奏曰：「逆賊王都首級請付所司。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: The Ministry of War of the Secretariat proclaimed the victory bulletin before the tower; when the proclamation ended, Vice Director of the Ministry of Punishments Zhang Wenbao memorialized: "The rebel Wang Du's head is requested to be delivered to the relevant office.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says War at the Secretariat proclaimed the bulletin at the tower; when it ended Zhang Wenbao of Punishments asked that Wang Du's head be given to the proper office.

sentences.zh: 」大理卿蕭希甫受之以出，獻於郊社，其王都男並蕃將等磔於開封橋。）〉

translations.literal: " Director of the Court of Judicial Review Xiao Xifu received it and went out, offered it at the suburban altars, and Wang Du's sons and the Tangut generals were dismembered at Kaifeng Bridge.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " Judicial review director Xiao Xifu took it out and offered it at the suburban altars; Wang Du's sons and Tangut generals were dismembered at Kaifeng Bridge.)〉

sentences.zh: 時露布之文，類制敕之體，蓋執筆者誤，頗為識者所嗤。

translations.literal: At the time the victory bulletin's text resembled the style of an edict—probably the scribe's error—and was much ridiculed by the knowing.
translations.idiomatic: The bulletin read like an edict, a scribe's mistake that critics mocked.

sentences.zh: 樞密使趙敬怡卒，贈太傅。

translations.literal: Privy Commissioner Zhao Jingyi died and was posthumously given Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Jingyi died and was posthumously made grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 以端明殿學士趙鳳權知汴州軍州事。

translations.literal: Duanming Hall academician Zhao Feng was ordered to act as regent of Bian prefecture military headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Feng acted as regent at Bian.

sentences.zh: 甲子，車駕發汴州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the imperial carriage departed Bian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Mingzong left Bian.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，至鄭州。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he reached Zheng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he reached Zheng.

sentences.zh: 賜左僕射致仕鄭玨錢二十萬。

translations.literal: Retired Left Vice Director Zheng Jue was granted two hundred thousand in cash.
translations.idiomatic: Retired left vice director Zheng Jue received two hundred thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宰相崔協卒，詔贈尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Chancellor Cui Xie died; an edict posthumously gave Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Cui Xie died and was posthumously made right vice director.

sentences.zh: 東都留守、太子少傅李琪等奉，至偃師縣奉迎。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital regent and Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi and others came out to welcome him at Yanshi county.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qi, Eastern Capital regent and crown prince junior tutor, welcomed him at Yanshi.

sentences.zh: 時琪奏章中有「敗契丹之凶黨，破真定之逆城」之言。

translations.literal: At the time Qi's memorial had the words "defeated the Khitan villain faction" and "broke the rebel city of Zhending."
translations.idiomatic: Li Qi's welcome memorial called the Khitan a "villain faction" and Zhending a "rebel city."

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「契丹即為凶黨，真定不是逆城，李琪罰一月俸。

translations.literal: An edict said: "If the Khitan are already a villain faction, Zhending is not a rebel city—Li Qi is fined one month's salary.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong fined Li Qi one month's salary for calling the Khitan villains and Zhending a rebel city.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，車駕至自汴州。

translations.literal: 」On gengwu, the imperial carriage arrived from Bian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: 」On gengwu Mingzong arrived from Bian.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，馮道進表乞命相。

translations.literal: Third month, jiaxu: Feng Dao submitted a memorial begging appointment as chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the third month Feng Dao asked to be made chief minister.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔皇城使李從璨貶授房州司戶參軍，仍令盡命。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict demoted Imperial City commissioner Li Congcan to Fang prefecture registrar and still ordered his life ended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Congcan was demoted to Fang registrar and ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 從璨，帝之諸子也。

translations.literal: Congcan was one of the Emperor's sons.
translations.idiomatic: Congcan was Mingzong's son.

sentences.zh: 先是，帝巡幸汴州，留從璨以警大內，從璨因遊會節園，酒酣，戲登禦榻。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Emperor toured Bian prefecture he left Congcan to guard the inner palace; Congcan, while drunk at the Festival Garden, climbed the imperial couch in play.
translations.idiomatic: While Mingzong was at Bian he had left Congcan guarding the palace; drunk in the Festival Garden Congcan climbed the imperial couch in play.

sentences.zh: 安重誨奏之，故置於法焉。

translations.literal: An Chonghui reported it, so he was punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: An Chonghui reported him and he was punished.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，中書奏：「今後群臣內有乞假覲省者，請量賜茶藥。

translations.literal: On renchen, the Secretariat memorialized: "Hereafter, among the ministers, those who beg leave to visit kin, please grant tea and medicine as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the secretariat asked that ministers on leave for family visits be given tea and medicine.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以前鄆州節度使符習為汴州節度使。

translations.literal: On yiwei, former Yan prefecture military commissioner Fu Xi was made Bian prefecture military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Fu Xi of Yan became Bian commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔鄴都、幽、鎮、滄、邢、易、定等州管內百姓，除正稅外，放免諸色差配，以討王都之役，有挽運之勞也。

translations.literal: On bingshen, an edict for the commoners within the circuits of Yedu, You, Zhen, Cang, Xing, Yi, and Ding, besides regular tax, remitted every sort of differential levy, because of the labor of hauling in the campaign against Wang Du.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Mingzong remitted extra levies in Yedu, You, Zhen, Cang, Xing, Yi, and Ding beyond regular tax after the Wang Du campaign's transport burden.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子朔，禁鐵鑞錢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengzi new moon: iron pewter coins were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the fourth month iron pewter coin was banned.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，重修廣壽殿成，有司請以丹漆金碧飾之，帝曰：「此殿經焚，不可不修，但務宏壯，不勞華侈。

translations.literal: On renyin, reconstruction of the Guangshou Hall was finished; the relevant offices asked to adorn it with cinnabar lacquer, gold, and jade; the Emperor said: "This hall was burned and could not go unrepaired, but only seek grandeur—do not trouble with luxury.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Guangshou Hall was rebuilt; when offices asked for lacquer and gold Mingzong said it had been burned and must be restored grandly but not lavishly.

sentences.zh: 」湖南奏，敗荊南賊軍於石首鎮。

translations.literal: 」Hunan memorialized that Jingnan rebel troops were defeated at Shishou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: 」Hunan reported defeating Jingnan rebels at Shishou.

sentences.zh: 詔沿邊置場買馬，不許蕃部直至闕下。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that along the borders horse markets be set up and tribal peoples not be allowed to reach the court directly.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong ordered border horse markets and barred tribes from coming straight to court.

sentences.zh: 先是，党項諸蕃凡將到馬，無駑良並雲上進，國家雖約其價以給之，及計其館穀錫賚，所費不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Earlier, whenever Dangxiang tribes brought horses, good and poor alike were presented upward; though the state set prices to pay them, counting lodging, grain, and gifts, the expense was beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: Dangxiang tribes had brought all horses to court for set prices, but lodging and gifts made the cost enormous.

sentences.zh: 計司以為耗蠹中華，遂止之。

translations.literal: The accounting office deemed it a drain on China and therefore stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: The accounting office called it a drain and ended the practice.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以皇子北京留守、河東節度使從榮為河南尹，判六軍諸衛事；

translations.literal: On renzi, the prince, Beijing regent and Hedong military commissioner Congrong, was made Henan intendant, judging the Six Armies and all guards;
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Prince Congrong of Beijing and Hedong became Henan intendant judging the Six Armies;

sentences.zh: 以皇子河南尹、判六軍諸衛事從厚為北京留守；

translations.literal: the prince, Henan intendant judging the Six Armies and all guards Conghou, was made Beijing regent;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Conghou of Henan became Beijing regent;

sentences.zh: 以河陽節度使趙延壽為宋州節度使；

translations.literal: Heyang military commissioner Zhao Yanshou was made Song prefecture military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanshou of Heyang became Song commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以侍衛親軍都指揮使、鎮南軍節度使康義誠為河陽節度使。

translations.literal: commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard personal army and Zhennan Army military commissioner Kang Yicheng was made Heyang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: and Kang Yicheng of the palace guard and Zhennan became Heyang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 契丹寇雲州。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided Yun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan raided Yun.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，契丹遣捺括梅裏等來朝貢，稱取禿餒等骸骨，並斬於北市。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Khitan sent Nako Meri and others to court with tribute, claiming to take the bones of Tu Nei and others, who had also been beheaded at the northern market.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Khitan envoys led by Nako Meri came with tribute to claim Tu Nei's bones after his beheading at the north market.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以端明殿學士趙鳳為門下侍郎兼工部尚書、平章事。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Duanming Hall academician Zhao Feng was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Works, and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zhao Feng became secretariat vice director, minister of works, and grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，諫議大夫致仕、襲文宣公孔邈卒。

translations.literal: Remonstrating Censor-in-chief emeritus and heir to Duke Wenxuan of Culture Kong Miao died.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Miao, remonstrating censor emeritus and heir to Duke Wenxuan, died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以王建立、孔循帶中書直省吏歸藩，並追回。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Wang Jianli and Kong Xun taking Secretariat direct-office clerks back to their circuits were both recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Jianli and Kong Xun were recalled for taking secretariat clerks to their circuits.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幽州節度使趙德鈞兼北面行營招討使，鎮州節度使範延光加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On renxu, Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun was given added northern campaign headquarters commissioner; Zhen prefecture military commissioner Fan Yanguang was given Inspector Grand Mentor by inspection.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhao Dejun of Youzhou became northern campaign commissioner and Fan Yanguang of Zhen inspector grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，中書奏：「五月一日，應在京九品已上官，及諸道進奉使，請準貞元七年敕，就位起居，永為恒式。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the Secretariat memorialized: "On the first of the fifth month, every official of ninth rank and above who should be in the capital, and envoys presenting tribute from every circuit, should follow the Zhenyuan 7 edict, take position and perform the audience, and make this a constant rule forever.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the secretariat asked that on the fifth-month first all capital officials of ninth rank and up and tribute envoys follow the Zhenyuan 7 audience rule permanently.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳朔，帝御文明殿受朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jisi new moon: the Emperor took the Wenming Hall to receive court.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the fifth month Mingzong held court at the Wenming Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以夔州節度使西方鄴卒輟朝。

translations.literal: On bingzi, court was suspended because Kuizhou military commissioner Xi Fangye had died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi court was canceled for the death of Xi Fangye of Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，大理卿李保殷卒。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Director of the Court of Judicial Review Li Baoyin died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou judicial review director Li Baoyin died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以忠武軍節度使索自通為京兆尹，充西京留守；

translations.literal: On jimao, Zhongwu Army military commissioner Suo Zitong was made Jingzhao intendant, filling Western Capital regent;
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Suo Zitong of Zhongwu became Jingzhao intendant and Western Capital regent;

sentences.zh: 以左威衛上將軍朱漢賓為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: Left Majestic Guard senior general Zhu Hanbin was made Luzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hanbin became Lu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以黔州節度使安崇阮為夔州節度使，以左驍衛上將軍張溫為洋州節度使，以黔州留後楊漢賓為本州節度使。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Qian prefecture military commissioner An Chongruan was made Kuizhou military commissioner; Left Majestic Cavalry senior general Zhang Wen was made Yang prefecture military commissioner; Qian prefecture acting regent Yang Hanbin was made military commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou An Chongruan moved from Qian to Kuizhou, Zhang Wen became Yang commissioner, and Yang Hanbin full Qian commissioner.

sentences.zh: 中書奏：「太常寺定少帝諡昭宣光烈孝皇帝，廟號景宗。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Sacrifices has fixed the Young Emperor's posthumous title Emperor Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial, temple name Emperor Jing.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat said the sacrifices court had set the Young Emperor's posthumous name Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial and temple name Jing.

sentences.zh: 伏以少帝今不入廟，難以言宗，隻雲昭宣光烈孝皇帝。

translations.literal: We submit that since the Young Emperor is not now entered in the temple, it is hard to speak of a temple name—only say Emperor Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Young Emperor was not in the temple, it asked to drop the temple name and use only Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以鳳州武興軍留後陳皋為武興軍節度使，以新州威塞軍留後翟璋為威塞軍節度使。

translations.literal: On renchen, Feng prefecture Wuxing Army acting regent Chen Gao was made Wuxing Army military commissioner; Xin prefecture Weisai Army acting regent Zhai Zhang was made Weisai Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Chen Gao became Wuxing commissioner and Zhai Zhang Weisai commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以權知尚書右丞崔居儉為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On renchen, acting Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Cui Juyin was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Cui Juyin moved from acting to full right secretariat vice director.

sentences.zh: 詔葺天下廨宇。

translations.literal: An edict ordered repair of government offices throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong ordered government offices repaired empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 丙申，襄州奏，荊南高從誨乞歸順。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Xiang prefecture memorialized that Jingnan Gao Conghui begged to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Xiang reported Gao Conghui of Jingnan sought submission.

sentences.zh: 雲州奏，契丹犯塞。

translations.literal: Yun prefecture memorialized that the Khitan violated the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Yun reported Khitan border raids.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，以左散騎常侍姚顗為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinchou: Left Regular Cavalier Yao Hui was made Vice Director of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the sixth month Yao Hui became vice war minister.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，夔州節度使楊漢章移鎮雲州，以北京馬步軍都指揮使兼欽州刺史張敬達為鳳州節度使。

translations.literal: On renyin, Kuizhou military commissioner Yang Hanzhang was transferred to Yun prefecture; Beijing horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Qin prefecture military commissioner Zhang Jingda was made Feng prefecture military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Yang Hanzhang moved from Kuizhou to Yun and Zhang Jingda of Beijing became Feng commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前西京副留守事張遵誨行衛尉事，充客省使。

translations.literal: On guimao, former Western Capital deputy regent Zhang Zunhui performed the duties of Chamberlain for Dependencies and filled Commissioner of the Reception Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zhang Zunhui, former Luoyang deputy regent, became chamberlain for dependencies and reception commissioner.

sentences.zh: 國子博士田敏請葺四郊祠祭齋室。

translations.literal: National University libationer Tian Min requested repair of the suburban sacrifice fasting chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Libationer Tian Min asked to repair the suburban sacrifice fasting halls.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以沂州刺史張萬進為安北都護，充振武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Yi prefecture military commissioner Zhang Wanjin was made Protector-General Pacifying the North, filling Zhenwu Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zhang Wanjin of Yi became protector-general pacifying the north and Zhenwu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以宿州團練使康思立為利州節度使。

translations.literal: On wushen, Su prefecture training commissioner Kang Sili was made Lizhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Kang Sili of Su became Li commissioner.

sentences.zh: 登州刺史孫元停任，坐在任無名科率故也。

translations.literal: Deng prefecture military commissioner Sun Yuan was removed from office, sitting for unnamed levies while in post.
translations.idiomatic: Deng commissioner Sun Yuan was dismissed for unauthorized levies in office.

sentences.zh: 詔鄴都仍舊為魏府。

translations.literal: An edict restored Yedu to its former name as Weifu.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong restored Yedu's old name Weifu.

sentences.zh: 應魏府、汴州、益州宮殿悉去鴟尾，賜節度使為衙署。

translations.literal: At Weifu, Bian prefecture, and Yizhou all palace roof ornaments were removed and given to military commissioners as yamen offices.
translations.idiomatic: Roof ornaments were stripped from palaces at Weifu, Bian, and Yi and given to commissioners as offices.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以權知朔方軍留後、定難軍都知兵馬使韓澄為朔方留後。

translations.literal: On xinhai, acting regent of the Shuofang Army and Dingnan Army commander-in-chief Han Cheng was made Shuofang acting regent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Han Cheng became Shuofang acting regent.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以前潞州節度使符彥超為左驍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On guichou, former Luzhou military commissioner Fu Yanchao was made Left Majestic Cavalry senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Fu Yanchao became left majestic cavalry senior general.

sentences.zh: 詔：「諸道節度使行軍司馬，名位雖高，或帥臣不在，其州事宜委節度副使權知。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Every circuit military commissioner's campaign adjutant, though high in name, if the commander is absent the prefectural affairs of that circuit should be entrusted to the military vice commissioner to act.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong ordered that when a commissioner was away the vice commissioner should run circuit affairs.

sentences.zh: 」又詔：「藩郡所請賓幕及主事親從者，悉以名聞。

translations.literal: 」Another edict said: "For every fief circuit, all staff and chief clerks and personal followers requested should be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: 」Another edict required fief circuits to report all staff and followers by name.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，權知荊南軍府事高從誨上章首罪，乞修職貢，仍進銀三千兩贖罪。

translations.literal: 」On bingchen, acting regent of Jingnan military headquarters Gao Conghui submitted a memorial confessing guilt, begging to restore tribute duties, and still presenting three thousand taels of silver to redeem guilt.
translations.idiomatic: 」On bingchen Gao Conghui confessed guilt, offered to resume tribute, and sent three thousand taels of silver in atonement.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Emperor visited the Zhide Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Mingzong visited the Zhide Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔：「京城空地，課人蓋造。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Vacant land in the capital is to be taxed for people to build on.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong taxed vacant capital land to encourage building.

sentences.zh: 如無力者，許人請射營構。」

translations.literal: Those without means may request others to bid and construct."
translations.idiomatic: The poor could let others bid and build for them."

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，以前西京留守判官張鎛為司農卿。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengwu: former Western Capital regent's aide Zhang Bo was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the seventh month Zhang Bo, former Luoyang regent's aide, became imperial granaries director.

sentences.zh: 壬申，貶前左金吾上將軍毛璋為儒州長流百姓，尋賜自盡，以其在藩鎮陰蓄奸謀故也。

translations.literal: On renshen, former Left Gold Spears senior general Mao Zhang was demoted to commoner exiled to Ru prefecture; soon he was granted suicide, because while in a fief circuit he had secretly harbored treacherous designs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Mao Zhang was exiled to Ru as a commoner and soon ordered to kill himself for plotting treason in his circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，御史中丞呂夢奇責授太子右讚善大夫，坐曾借毛璋馬故也。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Censor-in-chief Lü Mengqi was demoted to Crown Prince Right Praise Officer, sitting for having once borrowed Mao Zhang's horse.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Lü Mengqi was demoted to crown prince praise officer for borrowing Mao Zhang's horse.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以工部侍郎任讚為左散騎常侍，以樞密直學士、左諫議大夫、充匭使閻至為工部侍郎充職。

translations.literal: On jimao, Minister of Works Ren Zan was made Left Regular Cavalier; Privy Council academician, Left Remonstrator, and Pouch commissioner Yan Zhi was made Minister of Works filling the post.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Ren Zan became left regular cavalier and Yan Zhi minister of works.

sentences.zh: 遂州進嘉禾，一莖九穗。

translations.literal: Suizhou presented auspicious grain, one stalk with nine ears.
translations.idiomatic: Suizhou presented auspicious grain with nine ears on one stalk.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以給事中、判大理卿事許光義為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On renwu, Attendant-in-Chief and acting Director of the Court of Judicial Review Xu Guangyi was made Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Xu Guangyi became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 史館上言：「所編修莊宗一朝事跡，欲名為實錄，太祖、獻祖、懿祖名為紀年錄。

translations.literal: The Historiography Office memorialized: "The events of the Zhuangzong reign now being compiled are wished to be titled Veritable Records; the Founding Ancestor, Offering Ancestor, and Honored Ancestor are wished to be titled Chronological Records.
translations.idiomatic: The historiography office asked to title Zhuangzong's reign Veritable Records and the three ancestors Chronological Records.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：天成三年十二月，史館奏：「據左補闕張昭遠狀：『嘗讀國書，伏見懿祖昭烈皇帝自元和之初，獻祖文皇帝於太和之際，立功王室，陳力國朝。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Twelfth month of Tiancheng 3, the Historiography Office memorialized: "According to the memorial of Left Remonstrator Zhang Zhaoyuan: 'Having read the state histories, I see the Honored Ancestor Illustrious Emperor from the beginning of Yuanhe, the Offering Ancestor Cultured Emperor in the Taihe period, both serving the royal house and exerting strength for the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says in the twelfth month of Tiancheng 3 the historiography office cited Zhang Zhaoyuan: he had read the state histories and found the honored and offering ancestors had served the Tang from Yuanhe and Taihe onward.

sentences.zh: 太祖武皇帝自咸通後來，勤王戮力，翦平多難，頻立大功，三換節旄，再安京國。

translations.literal: The Founding Martial Emperor from after Xiantong came repeatedly to aid the throne and cut down many difficulties, often establishing great merit, thrice changing his commission, twice securing the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The founding martial emperor after Xiantong had repeatedly saved the capital and won great merit with three commission changes.

sentences.zh: 莊宗皇帝終平大憝，奄有中原，倘闕編修，遂成湮墜。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhuangzong finally pacified the great enemy and suddenly held the Central Plains; if compilation is lacking, it will sink into oblivion.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong had pacified the realm; without compilation their deeds would be lost.

sentences.zh: 伏請與當館修撰，參序條綱，撰太祖、莊宗實錄者。

translations.literal: I beg to compile with the office's editors in ordered outline the Veritable Records of the Founding Ancestor and Zhuangzong."』
translations.idiomatic: He asked to compile Veritable Records of the founding ancestor and Zhuangzong with the office."』

sentences.zh: 』」四年七月，監修國史趙鳳奏：「奉敕修懿祖、獻祖、太祖、莊宗四帝實錄，自今年六月一日起手，旋具進呈。

translations.literal: 」Seventh month, year 4, supervising compiler of state history Zhao Feng memorialized: "By edict we compile the Veritable Records of the Honored, Offering, Founding, and Zhuangzong emperors, beginning this sixth month and soon to present them.
translations.idiomatic: 」In the seventh month of year 4 Zhao Feng reported compiling the four emperors' records from the sixth month onward.

sentences.zh: 伏以凡關纂述，務合品題。

translations.literal: We submit that in every compilation the titles must fit the subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Titles had to fit each subject.

sentences.zh: 承乾禦宇之君，行事方雲實錄；

translations.literal: For rulers who took the throne in their own right, their acts are properly called Veritable Records;
translations.idiomatic: Reigning emperors' acts were Veritable Records;

sentences.zh: 追尊冊號之帝，約文隻可紀年。

translations.literal: for emperors posthumously honored with temple names, the text may only be Chronological Records.
translations.idiomatic: posthumously titled ancestors could only be Chronological Records.

sentences.zh: 所修前件史書，今欲自莊宗一朝名為實錄，其太祖以上並目為紀年錄。

translations.literal: For the histories compiled above, it is now wished that the Zhuangzong reign alone be named Veritable Records, and all from the Founding Ancestor upward be titled Chronological Records.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Feng proposed Zhuangzong alone as Veritable Records and the founding ancestor and above as Chronological Records.

translations.literal: " It was approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.)〉

sentences.zh: 甲申，以前荊南行軍司馬、檢校太傅高從誨起復，授檢校太傅、兼侍中，充荊南節度使。

translations.literal: On jiashen, former Jingnan campaign marshal and honorary Grand Preceptor Gao Conghui was recalled to service and made honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Palace Attendant, and Jingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Gao Conghui—former Jingnan campaign marshal and honorary grand preceptor—was recalled and made honorary grand preceptor, palace attendant, and Jingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，涇州節度使李從昶移鎮華州，以冀州刺史李金全為涇州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Jing military commissioner Li Congchang was transferred to Hua; Jizhou prefect Li Jinquan was made Jing military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Congchang of Jing moved to Hua and Li Jinquan of Ji became Jing commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊子，中書奏：「今後新及第舉人，有曾授正官及禦署者，欲約前任資序，與除一官。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat memorialized: "Hereafter among newly passed jinshi, those who had formerly held regular office or imperial secretariat posts should, in accord with prior rank and seniority, receive one additional office.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said: "New jinshi who had held regular office or imperial secretariat posts should receive one further office by prior rank and seniority.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔取來年二月二十一日有事於南郊。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict set the southern suburban rites for the twenty-first of the second month of next year.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Mingzong set the southern suburban rites for the twenty-first of the second month of next year.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉朔，大理正路阮奏：「切見春秋釋奠於文宣王，而武成王廟久曠時祭，請復常祀。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingyou: Grand Court Corrector Lu Ruan memorialized: "I observe that in spring and autumn the libation to Confucius is performed, yet the temple of the Martial Completion King has long lacked regular sacrifice; I ask that regular worship be restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the eighth month Lu Ruan, grand court corrector, said: "Spring and autumn sacrifices reach Confucius, yet the Martial Completion King has long lacked regular rites; I ask that worship be restored.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，中書奏：「太子少傅李琪所撰進《霍彥威神道碑》文，不分真偽，是混功名，望令改撰。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Central Secretariat memorialized: "The spirit-way stele text for Huo Yanwei submitted by Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi does not distinguish true from false and confounds merit and name; we ask that it be rewritten.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Secretariat said: "Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi's spirit-way stele for Huo Yanwei confounds true and false and merit and name; we ask that it be rewritten.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 琪，梁之故相，私懷感遇，敘彥威在梁曆任，不欲言偽梁故也。

translations.literal: Qi was a former Liang chancellor who privately cherished gratitude for favor and in narrating Yanwei's Liang service did not wish to speak of false Liang—hence this.
translations.idiomatic: Qi had been a Liang chancellor who cherished old favor and, narrating Yanwei's Liang service, avoided naming false Liang—hence the fault.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔：「亂離已來，天下諸軍所掠生口，有主識認，即勒還之。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict said: "Since the age of turmoil, among captives seized by armies under Heaven, where owners can be identified they are to be compelled to return them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict said: "Since the turmoil, captives taken by armies under Heaven, when owners can be identified, must be returned.

sentences.zh: 」以前清河縣令、襲酅國公、食邑三千戶楊仁矩為秘書丞。

translations.literal: Former Qinghe county magistrate Yang Renju, enfeoffed Duke of E with a fief of three thousand households, was made Secretariat aide.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Renju, former magistrate of Qinghe and Duke of E with three thousand fief households, became Secretariat aide.

sentences.zh: 御史台奏：「主簿朱穎是前中丞奏請，合隨聽罷任。

translations.literal: The Censorate memorialized: "Registrar Zhu Ying was requested by the former censor-in-chief and should leave office with his patron.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate said: "Registrar Zhu Ying had been the former censor-in-chief's appointee and should leave when his patron did.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「主簿既為正秩，況入選門，顯自朝恩，合終考限，宜令仍舊守官。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The registrar already holds regular rank and moreover entered through the selection gate; the favor was plainly from court and he should complete his review term—let him remain in office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "The registrar already held regular rank and had entered by selection; the appointment was plainly from court and he should finish his term—let him remain.

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，以宰臣馮道為南郊大禮使，兵部尚書盧質為禮儀使，御史中丞許光義為儀仗使，兵部侍郎姚顗為鹵簿使，河南尹從榮為橋道頓遞使，客省使、衛尉卿張遵誨為修裝法物使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Chancellor Feng Dao was made southern suburban chief ritualist; Minister of War Lu Zhi ritualist; Censor-in-Chief Xu Guangyi equipage master; Vice Minister of War Yao Yan halberd master; Henan prefect Congrong bridge and relay master; Guest Bureau commissioner and Director of the Court for the Imperial Clan Zhang Zunhui repair and regalia master.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Feng Dao became southern suburban chief ritualist; Lu Zhi of War, ritualist; Xu Guangyi, censor-in-chief, equipage master; Yao Yan of War, halberd master; Congrong of Henan, bridge and relay master; Zhang Zunhui, guest commissioner and Court of the Imperial Clan director, repair and regalia master.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，黑水朝貢使郭濟等率屬來朝，授歸德司戈，放還蕃。

translations.literal: On yisi Black River tribute envoy Guo Ji and others led their tribes to court; they were made Returned Virtue company commanders and sent back to their tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Guo Ji of Black River and others led their tribes to court, were made Returned Virtue company commanders, and were sent home.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以翰林學士承旨、禮部侍郎、知制誥李愚為兵部侍郎，職如故。

translations.literal: On dingwei Hanlin academician exequatur, Vice Minister of Rites, and edict drafter Li Yu was made Vice Minister of War at his post.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Yu—Hanlin exequatur, vice minister of rites, and edict drafter—became vice minister of war at rank.

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人盧詹為禮部侍郎，以兵部侍郎裴皞為太子賓客。

translations.literal: Secretariat drafting officer Lu Zhan was made Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of War Pei Hao was made crown prince mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhan became vice minister of rites; Pei Hao of War became crown prince mentor.

sentences.zh: 吐渾首領念公山來朝貢。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun chieftain Nian Gongshan came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun chieftain Nian Gongshan presented tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 戊申，帝服袞冕，禦文明殿，追冊昭宣光烈孝皇帝。

translations.literal: On wushen the Emperor wore full regalia and held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to posthumously ennoble Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Mingzong in full regalia held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to posthumously ennoble Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以宰臣、監修國史趙鳳兼判集賢院事，以左散騎常侍任讚判大理卿事。

translations.literal: On gengxu Chancellor and supervising historiographer Zhao Feng was made concurrent Director of the Hall of Assembled Worthies; Left Regular Attendant Ren Zan judged Director of the Court of Judicial Review affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhao Feng—chancellor and supervising historiographer—also directed the Hall of Assembled Worthies; Ren Zan, left regular attendant, judged Court of Judicial Review affairs.

sentences.zh: 己未，高麗王王建遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On jiwei King Jian of Goryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei King Jian of Goryeo sent envoys with local tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔：「準往例，節度使帶平章事、侍中、中書令，並列銜於敕牒，側書『使』字。

translations.literal: An edict said: "By former precedent, military commissioners bearing concurrent Grand Councilor, Palace Attendant, or Secretariat Director titles all listed those titles on edict slips with the character 'commissioner' written to the side.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "By precedent, commissioners with concurrent grand councilor, palace attendant, or secretariat director titles listed them on edict slips with 'commissioner' written to the side.

sentences.zh: 今錢鏐是元帥、尚父，與使相名殊，馬殷守太師、尚書令，是南省官資，不合署敕尾，今後敕牒內並落下。

translations.literal: Now Qian Liu is Marshal-in-Chief and Imperial Father, a title unlike commissioners; Ma Yin holds Grand Preceptor and Master of Writing, a southern-department rank unfit for signing edict tails—hereafter let both be omitted from edict slips.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu is marshal-in-chief and imperial father, unlike commissioners; Ma Yin holds grand preceptor and master of writing, a southern rank unfit for edict tails—hereafter omit both from edict slips.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，党項首領朝貢。

translations.literal: " On yimao Tangut chieftains presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: " On yimao Tangut chieftains presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸金真觀，改賜建法大師，賜紫尼智願為圓惠大師，即武皇夫人陳氏也。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Emperor visited the Golden Truth Abbey, changed the bestowed title to Great Master Jianfa, and bestowed purple on the nun Zhiyuan as Great Master Yuanhui—she was Lady Chen, consort of Martial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Mingzong visited Golden Truth Abbey, changed the bestowed title to Great Master Jianfa, and bestowed purple on the nun Zhiyuan as Great Master Yuanhui—Lady Chen, consort of Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，達靼來朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Dadan came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Dadan presented tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 京城內有南州、北州，乃張全義光啟中所築。

translations.literal: Within the capital were Southern and Northern Wards, built by Zhang Quanyi in the Guangqi era.
translations.idiomatic: The capital held Southern and Northern wards that Zhang Quanyi had built in the Guangqi era.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔許人依街巷請射城濠，任使平填，蓋造屋宇。

translations.literal: At this time an edict allowed people to bid by ward and lane to fill the moat and build houses as they wished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then allowed people to bid by ward and lane to fill the moat and build houses freely.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，中書奏：「據宗正寺申，懿祖永興陵、獻祖長寧陵、太祖建極陵並在代州雁門縣，皇帝追尊四廟在應州金城縣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingmao: the Central Secretariat memorialized: "According to the Imperial Clan Court, the tombs of Illustrious Ancestor Yongxing, Exalted Ancestor Changning, and Martial Ancestor Establishing the Utmost all lie in Yanmen county, Dai prefecture; the Emperor's four posthumous temples lie in Jincheng county, Ying prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the ninth month the Secretariat said: "The Imperial Clan Court reports Illustrious Ancestor Yongxing, Exalted Ancestor Changning, and Martial Ancestor Establishing the Utmost in Yanmen, Dai, while the four posthumous temples stand in Jincheng, Ying.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「應州升為望州，金城、雁門並升為望縣。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Ying prefecture is raised to a superior prefecture; Jincheng and Yanmen are each raised to superior counties.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Raise Ying to a superior prefecture and Jincheng and Yanmen to superior counties.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，太常博士段顒奏：「切見大祠則差宰相行事，中祠則卿監行事，小祠則委太祝、奉禮，並不差官，今後請差五品官行事。

translations.literal: On xinyou Court of Imperial Sacrifices academician Duan Yan memorialized: "I observe that for great sacrifices a chancellor is dispatched to perform the rite, for middle sacrifices a director or supervisor, and for small sacrifices the Grand Invoker or Ceremonial Attendant is entrusted without dispatching an official; hereafter let fifth-rank officials perform the rite.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Duan Yan of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices said: "Great sacrifices send a chancellor, middle ones a director or supervisor, and small ones leave the grand invoker or ceremonial attendant without an envoy; hereafter let fifth-rank officials perform the rite.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，製天下兵馬元帥、尚父、吳越國王錢鏐可落元帥、尚父、吳越國王，授太師致仕，責無禮也。

translations.literal: On guisi an edict stripped All-Armies Marshal-in-Chief, Imperial Father, and King of Wu-Yue Qian Liu of marshal, imperial father, and king of Wu-Yue and made him Grand Preceptor in retirement—for lack of ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Mingzong stripped Qian Liu of Wu-Yue of marshal, imperial father, and king and made him retired grand preceptor—for lack of ritual.

sentences.zh: 先是，上將軍烏昭遇使於兩浙，以朝廷事私於吳人，仍目鏐為殿下，自稱臣，謁鏐行拜蹈之禮。

translations.literal: Earlier, Senior General Wu Zhaoyu had been envoy to the two Zhes and divulged court affairs to the Wu men, also calling Liu "Your Highness" and himself "your subject," performing bowing and prostration when he met Liu.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Senior General Wu Zhaoyu had gone to the two Zhes, divulged court affairs to Wu men, called Liu "Your Highness" and himself "your subject," and bowed and prostrated on meeting him.

sentences.zh: 及回，使副劉玫具述其事，故停削鏐官爵，令致仕。

translations.literal: On his return deputy envoy Liu Mei fully reported the matter; hence Liu's titles were suspended and he was ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy envoy Liu Mei reported it fully on return; Liu's titles were cut and he was ordered to retire.

sentences.zh: 烏昭遇下御史台，尋賜自盡。

translations.literal: Wu Zhaoyu was sent to the Censorate and soon ordered to kill himself.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhaoyu went to the Censorate and soon was ordered to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 後有自浙中使還者，言昭遇無臣鏐之事，為玫所誣，人頗以為冤。

translations.literal: Later an envoy returning from Zhe said Zhaoyu had never treated Liu as sovereign and that Mei had framed him; many thought it a grievous injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Later an envoy from Zhe said Zhaoyu had never treated Liu as sovereign and Mei had framed him; many thought it unjust.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔諸道通勘兩浙綱運進奉使，並下巡獄。

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict ordered every circuit to investigate and arrest envoys of the two Zhes who presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict ordered every circuit to investigate and arrest two-Zhe tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申朔，並吏部三銓為一銓，宜令本司官員同商量注擬，連署申奏，仍不得於私第注官。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingshen: the three Personnel Bureaus were merged into one; officials of this office should jointly deliberate nominations, countersign memorials, and must not assign offices from private residences.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the tenth month of winter the three Personnel Bureaus merged into one; its officers were to deliberate nominations jointly, countersign memorials, and not assign posts from private homes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以襄州兵馬都監、守磁州刺史康福為朔方、河西等節度使，靈、威、雄、警、涼等州觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuxu Xiangzhou army supervisor and acting Ci prefect Kang Fu was made military commissioner of Shuofang, Hexi, and the rest, and observation commissioner of Ling, Wei, Xiong, Jing, and Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Kang Fu—Xiang army supervisor and acting Ci prefect—became Shuofang and Hexi commissioner and observer of Ling, Wei, Xiong, Jing, and Liang.

sentences.zh: 時朔方將吏請帥於朝廷，故命福往鎮之。

translations.literal: At the time Shuofang officers and clerks asked the court for a commander; hence Fu was ordered to take the post.
translations.idiomatic: Shuofang officers had asked court for a commander; hence Fu was sent to take the post.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以右金吾上將軍史敬鎔為左金吾上將軍，以左驍衛上將軍符彥超為右金吾上將軍，以前黔州節度使李承約為右驍衛上將軍，以雲州節度使張敬詢為左驍衛上將軍，以前華州節度使王景戡為右驍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On gengzi Right Golden Guard senior general Shi Jingrong was made Left Golden Guard senior general; Left Martial Cavalry senior general Fu Yanchao was made Right Golden Guard senior general; former Qian military commissioner Li Chengyue was made Right Martial Cavalry senior general; Yun military commissioner Zhang Jingxun was made Left Martial Cavalry senior general; former Hua military commissioner Wang Jingzhan was made Right Martial Cavalry senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Shi Jingrong became left golden guard senior general; Fu Yanchao, left martial cavalry senior general, right golden guard senior general; Li Chengyue, former Qian commissioner, right martial cavalry senior general; Zhang Jingxun of Yun, left martial cavalry senior general; Wang Jingzhan, former Hua commissioner, right martial cavalry senior general.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太常少卿蕭願責授太子洗馬，奪緋。

translations.literal: On guimao Court of Imperial Sacrifices vice director Xiao Yuan was demoted to crown prince groom and stripped of crimson.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Xiao Yuan, vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was demoted to crown prince groom and stripped of crimson.

sentences.zh: 願南郊行事，與祠官同飲，詰旦猶醉不能行禮，為御史所劾也。

translations.literal: At the southern suburban rites Yuan drank with the ritual officers; at dawn he was still drunk and could not perform the rites—the censorate impeached him.
translations.idiomatic: At the southern suburban rites Yuan drank with the ritual officers and at dawn was still too drunk to perform—the censorate impeached him.

sentences.zh: 詔新授朔方節度使康福將兵萬人赴鎮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered newly appointed Shuofang military commissioner Kang Fu to lead ten thousand troops to his post.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered newly appointed Shuofang commissioner Kang Fu to march ten thousand troops to his post.

sentences.zh: 己酉，製復故荊南節度使高季興官爵。

translations.literal: On jiyou an edict restored former Jingnan military commissioner Gao Jixing's office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Mingzong restored former Jingnan commissioner Gao Jixing's office and rank.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，升閬州為保寧軍。

translations.literal: On xinhai Lang prefecture was raised to Baoning Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Lang was raised to Baoning Army.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以內客省使、左衛大將軍李仁矩為閬州節度使。

translations.literal: On renzi Inner Guest Bureau commissioner and Left Guard senior general Li Renju was made Lang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Li Renju—inner guest commissioner and left guard senior general—became Lang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 幸七星亭。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited the Seven Stars Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong visited the Seven Stars Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，夏州進白鷹，重誨奏曰：「夏州違詔進貢，臣已止約。

translations.literal: On bingchen Xia presented a white hawk; Chonghui memorialized: "Xia has presented tribute in violation of the edict; your servant has already stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Xia presented a white hawk; Chonghui said: "Xia has violated the edict with tribute; I have already stopped it.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「善。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Good.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said: "Good.

sentences.zh: 」朝退，帝密令左右進焉。

translations.literal: After court was dismissed the Emperor secretly ordered attendants to present it.
translations.idiomatic: After court he secretly ordered attendants to bring it in.

sentences.zh: 是日，幸龍門。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: That day Mingzong visited Longmen.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，洛州水暴漲，壞居人垣舍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingmao: Luozhou waters rose violently and destroyed people's walls and houses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the eleventh month Lu waters rose violently and destroyed dwellings.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以刑部侍郎張文寶為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On wuchen Vice Minister of Punishments Zhang Wenbao was made Right Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhang Wenbao of Punishments became right regular attendant.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以尚書右丞李光序為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: On jisi Right Vice Director Li Guangxu was made Vice Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Li Guangxu, right vice director, became vice minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，升曹州濟陰縣為次赤，以昭宣光烈孝皇帝溫陵所在故也。

translations.literal: On guiyou Jiyin county of Caozhou was raised to second-tier red because it was the site of Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao's Warm Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Jiyin of Cao was raised to second-tier red as the site of Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao's Warm Tomb.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，奉國軍節度使王延稟加兼侍中，從福建節度使王延鈞請也。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Fengguo Army military commissioner Wang Yanbin gained concurrent Palace Attendant at Fujian military commissioner Wang Yanjun's request.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Wang Yanbin of Fengguo gained concurrent palace attendant at Wang Yanjun of Fujian's request.

sentences.zh: 車駕出近郊，試夏州所進白鷹，戒左右勿令重誨知。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage went to the near suburbs to try the white hawk Xia had presented, warning attendants not to let Chonghui know.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong went to the near suburbs to fly Xia's white hawk, warning attendants to keep it from Chonghui.

sentences.zh: 己卯，日南至，帝御文明殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: On jimao, the winter solstice, the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to receive congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the winter solstice, Mingzong held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor for congratulation.

sentences.zh: 癸未，秘書少監於嶠配振武長流百姓，永不齒任，為宰臣趙鳳誣奏也。

translations.literal: On guiwei Secretariat vice director Yu Qiao was matched to a long-exiled commoner of Zhenwu and barred from office forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Yu Qiao, secretariat vice director, was matched to a Zhenwu long exile and barred forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.

sentences.zh: 史官張昭遠等以新修獻祖、懿祖、太祖《紀年錄》共二十卷、《莊宗實錄》三十卷上之，賜器帛有差。

translations.literal: Historiographers Zhang Zhaoyuan and others presented the newly compiled 《Chronicle Records》 of Exalted and Illustrious Ancestors and Martial Ancestor in twenty juan and the 《Veritable Record》 of Emperor Zhuangzong in thirty juan; vessels and silks were bestowed in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Historiographers Zhang Zhaoyuan and others presented the new 《Chronicle Records》 of the exalted and illustrious and martial ancestors in twenty juan and the 《Veritable Record》 of Zhuangzong in thirty juan; vessels and silks were graded by rank.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：監修趙鳳、修撰張昭遠、呂咸休各賜繒彩、銀器等。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Supervising compiler Zhao Feng, compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says supervising compiler Zhao Feng and compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)〉

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，靈武康福奏：「破野利、大蟲兩族三百餘帳於方渠，獲牛羊三萬。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingyou: Lingwu's Kang Fu memorialized: "We routed the Yeli and Dachong tribes—more than three hundred households—at Fangqu and took thirty thousand head of cattle and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the twelfth month Kang Fu of Lingwu reported routing the Yeli and Dachong—more than three hundred households—at Fangqu and taking thirty thousand cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，詔：「應授官及封贈官誥、舉人冬集等所費用物，一切官破。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict said: "All costs for appointment patents, enfeoffment patents, and winter gathering of examination candidates shall be borne entirely by the state.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict said: "All costs for appointment and enfeoffment patents and candidates' winter gathering shall be borne by the state.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，中書奏：「今後宰臣致齋內，不押班，不知印，不赴內殿起居。

translations.literal: On renxu the Central Secretariat memorialized: "Hereafter while chancellors are in ritual abstinence within the palace they shall not lead the court procession, hold the seal, or attend inner-palace levee.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Secretariat said: "While chancellors abstain for rites within the palace they shall not lead court procession, hold the seal, or attend inner levee.

sentences.zh: 或遇國忌，行事官已受誓戒，宜不赴行香，並不奏刑殺公事。

translations.literal: When a state mourning day occurs, if the ritual officer has already taken the oath he should not attend incense offering, and capital punishment matters should not be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: On state mourning days, ritual officers already sworn should not attend incense, and capital cases should not be memorialized.

sentences.zh: 大祠致齋內，請不開宴。

translations.literal: During great-sacrifice abstinence, banquets should not be held.
translations.idiomatic: During great-sacrifice abstinence, banquets should not be held.

sentences.zh: 每遇大忌前一日，請不坐朝。

translations.literal: On the day before each great mourning day, court should not sit.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before each great mourning day, court should not sit.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.
